title: Pongal Morning in a Singapore Tamil Home
S_subject: A fictional multigenerational Tamil family: father Arun, 35, short black hair, cream cotton shirt and white veshti; mother Meena, 33, braided black hair, maroon saree with a subtle gold border; daughter Kavya, 9, braided hair and mustard-yellow festive dress; grandmother Lakshmi, 65, grey hair in a bun and green cotton saree. Preserve their faces, ages, clothing and body proportions in all Pongal scenes.
C_composition: Wide eye-level view with the family in the foreground, festival decorations in the middle ground, and a recognizable modern Singapore apartment setting in the background.
A_action: Show one still moment: Meena serving already-cooked sweet Pongal to the seated family. A decorated pot rests on a heatproof kitchen surface in the background.
L_location: A fictional Tamil family home in a contemporary Singapore HDB apartment, with residential blocks visible through a window.
E_aesthetic: Photorealistic documentary style, warm natural light, realistic skin tones, detailed festive fabrics and natural expressions.
constraints: Show one illustrative family, not a universal portrayal of all Tamil residents.
Keep modern Singapore architecture; avoid a rural Tamil Nadu landscape.
Use the regular kitchen stove for cooking, with clear space around it.
Keep anatomy, food, utensils and decorations realistic.
No invented readable signs, logos or watermarks.
